reason: The Repeat combobox has autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token that suppresses autofill. The field chooses a transfer frequency, which is not one of the 1.3.5 input purposes, and the accessibility tree still exposes role combobox, name frequency and its states, so no A or AA criterion fails.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the purposes in its Input Purposes list (name, address, email, card number and so on). The Repeat field picks how often a transfer rule runs, so it has no listed purpose and 1.3.5 does not apply. The attribute is autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token used to switch off browser autofill, which is why axe flags it; no assistive technology is told a wrong purpose. 4.1.2 passes: the probe shows role combobox, name frequency, expanded and haspopup states. 3.3.2 passes: the field has a visible Repeat label and a name. No other A or AA criterion concerns the token.
